EEG_benchmark_conclusion: The prespecified success target was not met.
scope: Competition-only exploratory composite model; standalone neuroscience project is unchanged

architecture.EEG_trainable: Three-seed ensemble of 16,296-parameter residual temporal convolutional networks
architecture.temporal_input: 88 ordered coverage-supported bins at 2 Hz over a 44-second context
architecture.preprocessing: Training-fold scaling and PCA capped at 16 dimensions per block, fitted to unique training content
architecture.auxiliary: SAM visual, SAM Audio, semantic, sensory, and progress descriptors enter after temporal pooling
architecture.variance_output: Positive softplus parameterization; no post-hoc clipping
architecture.training_boundary: Only the small EEG model and its transforms were trained; the fMRI branch is unchanged
architecture.inference_mode: Whole-lesson offline prediction; encoder context may be bidirectional, so this is not causal real-time forecasting

data.effective_sample_warning: Overlapping contexts and repeated participant targets do not create 1,020 independent lessons

targets.units: Training-source channel means and log1p population variances; no calibrated waveform claim
targets.alignment: Existing coarse receiver-to-reported-playback association; physical sample synchronization is unqualified
targets.signal_quality: Channel calibration and artifact/contact quality remain unqualified
targets.not_individualized: Same content produces the same ensemble mean; no learned demographics or person-specific brain model

evaluation.design: Eight crossed participant-group/topic-family folds, no shared participants or lessons
evaluation.status: Exploratory reanalysis of previously evaluated lectures
evaluation.primary: Equal-lecture, equal-viewing MAE across eight targets normalized by training-fold target SD
evaluation.success_rule: At least 5% reduction versus TRIBE-only temporal comparator and better than training mean

primary_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis of four previously evaluated lectures, conditional on fixed fits; not a fresh population-level validation.

tribe_temporal.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis of four previously evaluated lectures, conditional on fixed fits; not a fresh population-level validation.

mean.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis of four previously evaluated lectures, conditional on fixed fits; not a fresh population-level validation.

tribe_ridge.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis of four previously evaluated lectures, conditional on fixed fits; not a fresh population-level validation.

without_tribe.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis of four previously evaluated lectures, conditional on fixed fits; not a fresh population-level validation.

shuffled_fusion.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis of four previously evaluated lectures, conditional on fixed fits; not a fresh population-level validation.

evaluation.negative_control_interpretation: The shuffled-target control matched or outperformed fusion. These results do not establish that correct within-viewing temporal EEG pairing improves prediction.
evaluation.incremental_TRIBE_interpretation: Adding TRIBE representations lowered point error relative to the no-TRIBE arm; uncertainty is reported separately.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired lecture/participant resampling conditional on fixed fits; four lectures cannot establish population generalization
evaluation.deployment: Separately fitted on all eligible rows after evaluation; its training predictions were never validation

inference.nonvideo_status: Experimental transfer from audiovisual training, with explicit absent-modality masks
inference.presentation_clock: Text requires reading pace; documents require page durations; these are assumptions, not measured gaze
inference.nonvideo_auxiliary: Unavailable window-level SAM/semantic/sensory descriptors are masked; only video has the qualified auxiliary assembly
inference.five_format_engineering_checks: Five versions of one original velocity lesson, no measured brain or behavioral ground truth
inference.output: Versioned JSON/NPZ; unsupported EEG values export as null; native cortical arrays and clocks are unchanged
inference.execution: Cloud pretrained content inference plus local fitted EEG head; not browser-only model execution
inference.local_runtime: PyTorch 2.14.1 via existing research interpreter or BRAIN_TORCH_PYTHON; research environment not modified

not_supported: Attention, distraction, cognitive load, learning, retention or quiz scores
Joint training on measured EEG and fMRI
Accuracy on silent reading or audio-only responses
Clinical or educational decisions about individual students
limitations_and_next_research: Independent lessons and participants are needed for fresh validation
Confirm physical EEG timing, channel units and contact/artifact quality before neural claims
A strong shuffled-label control would weaken any claim that temporal content relationships were learned
Behavioral attention or quiz outputs require separate audited labels and evaluation
privacy: Local-only bundle contains fitted EEG weights; do not include it in cloud content requests
